mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_asset (original_url, original_width, original_height, status, processor_version) VALUES (#{originalUrl}, #{originalWidth}, #{originalHeight}, 'PENDING', 1)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM image_asset WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE image_asset SET status='PROCESSING', worker_owner=#{owner}, lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 60 SECOND), attempts=attempts+1, error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND attempts < 3

UPDATE image_asset SET status='READY', variant_320_url=#{url320}, variant_640_url=#{url640}, variant_1280_url=#{url1280}, error_code=NULL, worker_owner=NULL, lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND worker_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > NOW()
UPDATE image_asset SET status='FAILED', error_code=#{errorCode}, worker_owner=NULL, lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND worker_owner=#{owner}
UPDATE image_asset SET status=IF(attempts < 3,'PENDING','FAILED'), error_code='WORKER_LOST', worker_owner=NULL, lease_until=NULL WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until < NOW()
UPDATE image_asset SET status='READY', variant_320_url=#{url320}, variant_640_url=#{url640}, variant_1280_url=#{url1280}, error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE image_asset SET status='FAILED', error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE image_asset SET status='PENDING', attempts=0, error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'
